reviewer: independent reviewer; did not build or edit R2

criteria.name: Identity and footprint
findings: The 2023 orthophoto overlay supports FID 857 as the large complex and FID 108 as a compact low-roof structure at the southeast edge.
Approximate campus transform and touching/overlapping polygons do not establish wall-level registration or the internal connection.

criteria.name: Placement and orientation
findings: Identity root and existing local XY are preserved; the entrance direction remains source-backed.
No read-only master placement-marker or linked-library check was performed; campus conversion is approximate.

criteria.name: Form, height, and roof
findings: FID 108's new 4.20 m wall top is a reasonable rounded estimate from a uniform 2018 5-ft DSM patch minus a same-coordinate bare-earth DEM sample; prior unsupported upper floors were excluded from the export collection.
The major FID 857 mass retains an unverified single 18.5 m height and broad flat roof despite documented phases and mixed roof forms.
Spatial DSM/DTM variation cannot be assigned to specific wings because returns may include equipment, parapets, and canopy, and no registered roof plan was located.

criteria.name: Facade, materials, and entrance
findings: R1 brick, dark windows, frames, bands, and arched entry have qualitative photographic support.
Rendered facade repeats a uniform window schedule across a broad wall; exact count/wing assignment and portal along-wall position remain unverified. R2 adds no facade-to-GIS registration.

criteria.name: Interior and circulation
findings: The 2025 emergency slides support current evacuation-route and vertical-core context, and 2015 study describes limited ME/Gatewood connections.
No current room/circulation geometry was edited; evacuation maps are not a complete measured as-built plan, and the detailed historic plans predate the current renovation.

criteria.name: Technical integrity
findings: Blender 5.2.3 reopened the asset; R2 validation passes with expected collection and identity root.
FID 108 XY bounds and FID 857 geometry are unchanged; unsupported FID 108 upper slabs are preserved outside the exported collection.

decision: Below 8.0/10. R2 credibly lowers the small FID 108 massing and clarifies its broad GIS identity, but major FID 857 roof/height, registered facade, and modeled current circulation remain unresolved.
